kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتقر (form VIII)
# أَحْتَقِرُ (ʔaḥtaqiru) /ʔaħ.ta.qi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# أُحْتَقَرُ (ʔuḥtaqaru) /ʔuħ.ta.qa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# أَحْتَقِرَ (ʔaḥtaqira) /ʔaħ.ta.qi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# أُحْتَقَرَ (ʔuḥtaqara) /ʔuħ.ta.qa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
